published_nonresponse_scientific_screen.source: Morgado et al 2025 Biodiversity Data Journal section Additional Information paragraph and Table 2; no independent current outcome read
published_nonresponse_scientific_screen.interpretation: The absence of meaningful alien-woody taxa variation makes the proposed within-island low-alien-vs-native-community-filtering test unestimable for Terceira and Réunion, and weak with only one possible alien woody taxon on Tenerife.

scientific_decision: Do not open BioMonI Event/Occurrence data to estimate any native-alien richness gradient; the published taxon summary already fails the predeclared source variation requirement. Do not silently switch the endpoint to woody abundance or island richness. Use a genuinely independent and comparably sampled forest gradient with both natural and altered stands.
